en: So model developer tools and coding agent,
zh: 所以模型、开发工具和编程智能体，

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the experience that users actually feel.

speaker: Unknown
en: The difference comes from the entire inference stack.
zh: 这种差异来自整个推理技术栈。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is the core of Friendly AI's value.

zh: Friendly AI 是作为一个面向 Gen AI 模型的全栈推理引擎来构建的。

zh: 这很重要,因为快速且可靠的推理不只是单一的优化。

zh: 它是批处理、调度、量化、投机解码以及 corners 的组合。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everything should work together.

speaker: Unknown
en: So let me briefly explain how we built that and how we make the inference performance to the cutting-edge level.
zh: 那么让我简要说明一下我们是如何构建这些、以及如何把推理性能做到前沿水平的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in the modern agent applications, inputs are often very long.
zh: 在现代智能体应用中,输入往往非常长。

speaker: Unknown
en: It easily exceeds 10k tokens while outputs are relatively short.
zh: 输入很容易超过 10k tokens,而输出相对较短。

speaker: Unknown
en: And more importantly, a large portion of the inputs are repeated across requests.
zh: 更重要的是,输入中有很大一部分在不同请求之间是重复的。

speaker: Unknown
en: In many real workloads, like 50% to 80% to 90% of the tokens are identical across different requests.
zh: 在许多真实的工作负载中,大约 50% 到 80% 到 90% 的 tokens 在不同请求之间是完全相同的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So from a system perspective, this means most of the compute cost is in the pre-filled stage, where the model processes the entire inputs and build a KB cache.
zh: 从系统角度看,这意味着大部分计算成本都在 pre-filled 阶段,即模型处理全部输入并构建 KB cache 的阶段。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if we recompute this shared prefix every time, you're wasting both latency and GPU cycles.
zh: 所以如果我们每次都重新计算这个共享前缀,就是在同时浪费延迟和 GPU cycles。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when a new recast share a prefix with the previous one, we can reuse those tensor and skip the corresponding preferred computation and directly reduce the TTFT and we can avoid computing large chunk of the input.
zh: 当一个新的 recast 与之前的请求共享前缀时,我们可以复用那些 tensor,跳过相应的 preferred 计算,从而直接降低 TTFT,并避免对大块输入进行计算。

speaker: Unknown
en: But however, making this work at scale requires two key mechanisms.
zh: 但是,要让这一机制在规模化下工作,需要两个关键机制。

speaker: Unknown
en: So first one is cache-aware routing.
zh: 第一个是 cache-aware routing(缓存感知路由)。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in the distributed system, KVCache is not centralized.
zh: 在分布式系统中,KVCache 不是集中式的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It lives on individual replicas.
zh: 它存在于各个副本上。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the router must send incoming requests to the replica that already holds the relevant prefix in its cache.
zh: 所以路由器必须把进来的请求发送到已经在其缓存中持有相关前缀的副本。

speaker: Unknown
en: Otherwise, we lose the benefit of reuse.
zh: 否则,我们就失去了复用的好处。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second thing is cache hierarchy.
zh: 第二点是缓存层级。

speaker: Unknown
en: So KVCache is extremely memory intensive.
zh: KVCache 对内存的消耗极其巨大。

speaker: Unknown
en: For large models and long contacts, KVCache size can exceed model weights.
zh: 对于大模型和长 contacts,KVCache 的大小可能超过模型权重。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as you know, GPU VRAM is the fastest, but there's also very limited resources.
zh: 如你所知,GPU VRAM 是最快的,但也是非常有限的资源。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we treat cache as a hierarchy, like hot cache stays in GPU memory, worm cache is in CPU RAM, and cordial cache can be offloaded to NVMe or the disk spaces.
zh: 所以我们把缓存当作层级来处理,比如热缓存放在 GPU 内存中,worm 缓存放在 CPU RAM 中,而 cordial 缓存可以卸载到 NVMe 或磁盘空间上。

speaker: Unknown
en: The system dynamically offloads less used blocks and prepares them when they need it.
zh: 系统会动态地把较少使用的块卸载出去,并在需要时重新载入。

speaker: Unknown
en: So by combining cache-aware routing and hierarchical memory management, we significantly reduce the prefix calls, lower TTFT, and making long-context agent workload much more efficient.
zh: 通过结合 cache-aware routing 和分层内存管理,我们显著减少了 prefix calls,降低了 TTFT,使长上下文智能体工作负载的效率大幅提升。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the next thing is interactive speed.
zh: 接下来是交互式速度。

speaker: Unknown
en: So standard autoregressive decoding, it generates one token per forward pass that makes decode inherently a sequencer, and during the decode, the GPU is often underutilized.
zh: 标准的自回归解码每次前向传播只生成一个 token,这使得 decode 天生是一个 sequencer,而且在 decode 期间,GPU 往往利用率不足。

speaker: Unknown
en: And speculative decoding changes the shape of this problem.
zh: 而投机解码改变这个问题的形态。

speaker: Unknown
en: So instead of generating one token and stopping, it proposes multiple candidates' tokens ahead.
zh: 它不是生成一个 token 就停下来,而是提前提出多个候选 tokens。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then the target model validates those candidates in a single pass, and if the tokens are accepted, they are free.
zh: 然后目标模型在单次前向传播中验证这些候选,如果 tokens 被接受,它们就是免费的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this improves time per output token without changing model's output quality.
zh: 这改善了每个输出 token 的时间,而且不改变模型的输出质量。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are different ways to draft candidates.
zh: 起草候选 tokens 有不同的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one way is model-based speculation.
zh: 一种是基于模型的投机。

speaker: Unknown
en: It uses a small draft model to predict the future tokens, and the benefit of it is it can achieve higher acceptance rate, but the cost is the extra compute.
zh: 它使用一个小型 draft 模型来预测未来的 tokens,好处是可以达到更高的接受率,但代价是额外的计算。

speaker: Unknown
en: And another method is model-free speculation.
zh: 另一种方法是无模型的投机。

speaker: Unknown
en: It uses pattern from a prompt or prior output, so it has lower overhead
zh: 它利用来自 prompt 或先前输出的模式,因此开销更低

speaker: Unknown
en: But it works best only when the output resembles the existing context.
zh: 但只有当输出与现有上下文相似时才效果最好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the important part is the tradeoff.
zh: 重要的是其中的权衡。

speaker: Unknown
en: So speculation can improve per request latency, but validation as overhead to the batch.
zh: 投机可以改善每请求延迟,但验证会给 batch 带来开销。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the best strategy is not static.
zh: 所以最佳策略不是静态的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And at Friendly AI, we take a hybrid approach.
zh: 在 Friendly AI,我们采取混合方法。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the runtime can dynamically select between model-based and model-free speculation based on the workload and request characteristic.
zh: 运行时可以根据工作负载和请求特征,在基于模型的投机和无模型的投机之间动态选择。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we also think about speculation as something we can improve over time.
zh: 我们还认为投机是可以随时间不断改进的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So with self evolving speculation, draft model can adapt based on the real serving traffic.
zh: 通过自我演化的投机,draft 模型可以根据真实的线上流量进行自适应调整。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the speculator continuously improves its prediction of the workload actually running in your production.
zh: 所以这个投机解码器会持续改进对你生产环境中实际运行负载的预测。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the next thing I want to mention is reliability.
zh: 接下来我想讲的是可靠性。

speaker: Unknown
en: So speed alone is not enough.
zh: 因为光有速度是不够的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So production AI application
zh: 对于生产环境的 AI 应用来说，

speaker: Unknown
en: Reliability is part of speed.
zh: 可靠性本身就是速度的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if an API is fast in average, but frequently hits timeout, like 5XX error, 4 to 9 rate limit, or that kind of failure, the user experiences scoot breaks.
zh: 如果一个 API 平均速度很快，但频繁碰到超时，比如 5XX 错误、429 限流，或者那类失败，用户感受到的就是 scooter 中断(照原文 scoot breaks 译)。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this becomes even more important for agent workloads.
zh: 所以这对智能体负载来说就更加重要了。

speaker: Unknown
en: As you know, agent may need multiple model cores to complete one task.
zh: 如你所知，一个智能体可能需要多次模型调用(model cores,照原文译)才能完成一个任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if just one call face in the middle, the entire workflow can be invalidated.
zh: 而如果中间哪怕只有一次调用失败(face,照原文译)，整个工作流都可能作废。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's why we do not optimize only for the latency or throughput.
zh: 这就是为什么我们不仅仅针对延迟或吞吐量做优化。

speaker: Unknown
en: We optimize the full API experiences, including the error rate, uptime, all those things together.
zh: 我们优化的是完整的 API 体验，包括错误率、正常运行时间，以及所有这些东西加在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this OpenAI snapshot for GLM 5.1 Pro shows that friendly AI is not only the fast, but it's also highly reliable with over 99.9% uptime.
zh: 而这份 OpenAI snapshot(照原文译)对 GLM 5.1 Pro 的数据显示，Friendly AI 不仅快，而且高度可靠，正常运行时间超过 99.9%。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what I want to say is many inference provider out here, of course in this venue as well, they will tell you that they are fast.
zh: 所以我想说的是，市面上有很多推理提供商，当然这个会场里也有，他们会告诉你他们很快。

speaker: Unknown
en: At some point of them, they are, but on certain benchmark, under a certain condition.
zh: 在某种程度上，他们确实快，但那是在某些基准上、在某些条件下。

speaker: Unknown
en: But for your application, the only benchmark that really matters is your own workload.
zh: 但对你的应用来说，唯一真正重要的基准是你自己的负载。

speaker: Unknown
en: So your prompt, your token lengths, your traffic patterns, and your latency expectation.
zh: 也就是你的 prompt、你的 token 长度、你的流量模式，以及你的延迟预期。

speaker: Unknown
en: So our recommendation is simple.
zh: 所以我们的建议很简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: So please bring your workload to us and test the poor experience with us in terms of speed, reliability, cost, and quality.
zh: 请把你的负载带过来，和我们测试完整的体验(poor experience,照原文译)，包括速度、可靠性、成本和质量。

speaker: Unknown
en: And of course, we build our inference service for exactly these production workloads, and we believe that we can give you the best experience.
zh: 当然，我们正是为这些生产负载构建我们的推理服务的，我们相信我们能给你最好的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have a boost in this venue, so bring your hardest problem to us, and let's solve it together.

zh: 在结束之前，
